scope_amendment.claim_boundary: The scope reduction is post hoc and must be disclosed in the paper and blog. Confirmatory optimizer claims are DenseOn-only. Existing LateOn discovery and mechanism artifacts remain available for audit but cannot supply missing controls or be selectively promoted as confirmatory evidence.

inference.familywise_interval: simultaneous familywise 95% interval over all six contrasts frozen before the post-hoc Dense-only scope amendment
inference.note: Intervals resample seeds and tasks independently. Aggregate MTEB JSON does not contain per-query rankings, so this report makes no query-level significance claim. Both nominal and Bonferroni familywise intervals are reported; only the familywise interval can determine positive, negative, or inconclusive headline language.
